name: Molten-Eyes Purity Dragon
text:
2+ "Molten-Eyes" monster
If this card is Summoned using a "Molten-Eyes" Link monster it gains ATK equal to the monsters Link Rating x200. Once Per Turn: You can destroy a "Molten-Eyes" Monster you control that this card points too. then this card gains ATK equal to that monsters level x200 until the end of the turn.
